Wait 20

C:CEFClockContract
Echo CEF-clock-returned:$RC >DEBUG:

Run >NIL: Execute S:CEF-StartupMonitor

Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run

Echo ARM56-probe-wait-failed >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf

Echo ARM56-probe-wait-returned:0 >DEBUG:
Type RAM:CEF-host.log >DEBUG:

Run SYS:System/About

Echo ARM56-host-exit-timeout >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
Type RAM:CEF-host.log >DEBUG:
Type RAM:CEF-appA.log >DEBUG:
Echo ARM56-test-finished >DEBUG:
Wait 3600
